conventions.notes: Every 4xx/5xx carries error_body. Unknown request fields and query params are ignored. IDs are opaque strings <=64 chars. Timestamps RFC 3339 with explicit offset. 'example' values are copied from the spec where it gives one. Stage 2: every payment carries authorization_id (null unless created by a capture). Seven idempotent write paths: stage 1's five plus POST /authorizations and POST /authorizations/{id}/capture.
